# Commit message convention

```
<Imperative summary in English, ≤ 72 chars>

- <mod>: <what changed and why>
- <mod>: ...
```

- Subject: imperative mood, capitalized, no trailing period (`Add …`, `Fix …`, `Improve …`)
- Body: one bullet per notable change, prefixed with the mod it touches (`git-graph:`, `todo-band:`); use `repo:` for changes outside a mod
- Leave a blank line between the subject and the body
